name: Martín Fernández
headline: Senior Data Engineer
summary: Senior Data Engineer with 8 years of experience designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and warehousing solutions. Skilled in building ETL/ELT workflows, optimizing SQL-based data models, and orchestrating batch processes with Airflow. Experienced working with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable data infrastructure for analytics and machine learning use cases.

responsibilities: Design and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines processing over 500GB of daily data using Airflow and Spark
Lead migration of on-premise data warehouse to AWS Redshift
Collaborate with data science team to productionize ML feature pipelines
Mentor junior data engineers on best practices for pipeline design and testing
Implement data quality checks and monitoring using Great Expectations
Built and maintained batch data pipelines for financial reporting systems
Developed reusable Python modules for data ingestion from third-party APIs
Optimized SQL queries and database indexes to improve report generation times
Automated workflow scheduling using Apache Airflow
Supported migration from legacy cron jobs to Airflow DAGs
Assisted in developing data extraction scripts for internal reporting tools
Maintained and monitored nightly ETL jobs
Wrote SQL queries to support ad-hoc business analysis requests
Documented data pipeline processes and troubleshooting procedures
